en: Conditioned by a state that is neither unwholesome nor of indeterminate destiny, a wholesome state of determinate destiny arises by way of root condition … [etc. … Under root condition there are six; … pe … under non-disappearance condition there are six.
Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor of indeterminate destiny, an indeterminate state of indeterminate destiny arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor of indeterminate destiny, an indeterminate state of indeterminate destiny arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither-indeterminate-nor-fixed, there arises a state that is indeterminate and not-fixed by way of the root-condition.

Dependent on a state that is neither-wholesome-nor-not-fixed and a state that is neither-indeterminate-nor-fixed, there arises a state that is indeterminate and not-fixed by way of the root-condition. Dependent on a state that is neither-unwholesome-nor-not-fixed and a state that is neither-indeterminate-nor-fixed...
Conditioned by [a state that is] indeterminate and undetermined, an indeterminate and undetermined state arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated.
There are five under the root condition, five under the predominance condition …pe… five under the non-disappearance condition.
